title: 细节的展开
goal: 能以时间、原因、数量和例子展开邮件要求，并排除无关细节。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

points.label: 用具体信息展开一条要求
判断内容是否对应题目的要求

sources.title: ETS：Writing Scoring Guide — Write an Email
sources.used: 0–5 分每一档的描述（本课是中文转述，原文以官方为准）

body.p: 细节让收件人能理解原因、核对事实或执行请求。常用的细节有四类：时间、原因、数量和例子。用哪几类，由题目要求决定。

body.box:
The arrangement is inconvenient.
The collection desk closes at four, but my placement ends at five.

body.p: 第二句写出两个时间的冲突，支持延长领取时段的请求。细节要与题目情境一致：不改动题目给出的日期，不编造已获得的许可。

cards.title: 细节的四个来源
rows: 时间
限定事件或期限，并写明是哪个动作的时间。
The parcel arrived on Tuesday, but the collection notice came on Thursday.
原因
把问题和后果连起来。because 后面写真实的解释。
I need a printed copy because the file cannot be opened on the display terminal.
数量
说明规模或范围，数量要支持请求。
Only two of the six name badges show the correct department.
例子
让笼统的评价可以核对。一个例子只说明一处问题。
For example, the entry for Room 9 still lists the previous occupant.

cards.title: 空泛句与具体句
rows: The pickup time is unsuitable.
The desk closes at four, but my placement ends at five.
两个时间说明冲突。
The file has a problem.
The file opens, but the final page is missing.
指出出问题的位置：最后一页缺失。
We need more chairs.
Twelve guests have confirmed, but the room has only eight chairs.
数量差说明缺口。
The directions are confusing.
The directions mention the east door, which is locked after six.
写出具体的门和锁门时间。
The list has several mistakes.
For example, two participants are listed twice under different initials.
用一个例子说明是哪种错误。
An earlier reply would help.
A reply by Tuesday would let us print the signs before Friday's event.
写出期限，并说明它影响哪件事。

cards.title: 细节与要求的对应
rows: 说明问题
The elevator stops at every floor except ours.
写出障碍本身。电梯颜色这类信息不写。
解释影响
This prevents us from moving the display upstairs.
写出这个问题造成的后果。
提出方案
The display could be moved through the side entrance.
方案针对这个障碍提出。
询问条件
Could you confirm whether that entrance permits trolley access?
问还不确定的条件，不写成已获许可。
表示感谢
Thank you for checking the entrance dimensions.
感谢对方的帮助。感谢不能代替要说明的信息。
删除旁支
The gallery opened ten years ago.
与场所有关，但与这次搬运无关，应删去。

body.box:
Task: Write to the textile-room assistant. Explain why a requested fabric roll is unsuitable, propose an alternative, and ask whether it can be supplied.
Notes: The requested roll is 90 cm wide. The pattern requires a single piece 110 cm wide. A 120 cm roll is listed in the stock catalog. Availability has not been checked.

Dear Textile-Room Assistant,
The 90 cm roll is too narrow because the pattern requires one piece at least 110 cm wide. The catalog lists a 120 cm roll, which would meet that requirement. Could you check whether it is currently available?
Best regards,
Liv

body.p: 90 cm 和 110 cm 的比较说明原来的布为什么不适用。120 cm 说明替代品能解决问题。catalog lists 只说明目录里有，库存还没确认，所以结尾要问 availability。

body.box:
Which detail would be unsupported?
1. The requested roll is narrower than the required piece.
2. A wider roll appears in the stock catalog.
3. The wider roll has already been reserved for the writer.
4. The pattern needs one piece rather than joined strips.

body.p: 第三项把还没确认的 availability 写成已经 reserved，材料里没有依据。第四项来自 a single piece，是对要求的具体说明。

groups.text:
Task: Explain why the cloakroom needs additional hangers.
Notes: Thirty coats are expected. Twenty hangers are available. The cloakroom closes at nine.
Draft: Dear Event Manager, We need more hangers.

items.stem: Which addition best quantifies the need?
options: The cloakroom is open until nine.
The expected coats exceed the available hangers by ten.
Twenty coats are expected to arrive after nine.
Thirty hangers are needed in addition to the existing twenty.
items.why: Thirty coats 和 Twenty hangers 相差 10 个，即第二项。第四项把缺口写成了另加 30 个。

items.stem: Which detail is least relevant to explaining the shortage?
options: The number of coats expected
The number of hangers currently available
The cloakroom's closing time
The difference between coats and hangers
items.why: closes at nine 是关门时间，与衣架不够无关，即第三项。其他三项都是说明短缺的数量。

groups.text:
Task: Explain why instructions for using a campus scanner need revision.
Notes: The guide says to press a green button. The new scanner has a touchscreen with an Upload icon. The guide is printed on blue paper.
Draft: Dear Documentation Team, The guide no longer matches the scanner.

items.stem: Which detail directly illustrates the mismatch?
options: The scanner is used with a guide printed on blue paper.
The guide's paper color differs from the old green button.
The printed guide describes the new touchscreen as green.
The guide names a button, while the device uses an on-screen icon.
items.why: press a green button 和 touchscreen with an Upload icon 对照，说明指南和机器的操作方式不同，即第四项。

items.stem: Which addition would remain on topic but fail to support the requested revision?
options: The guide is printed on blue paper.
The new device lacks the described physical button.
The instructions should identify the Upload icon.
The described control differs from the one users actually see.
items.why: blue paper 只是纸的颜色，与指南为什么要改无关，即第一项。其他三项说的都是按键和图标不一致。

items.stem: Only two battery packs are charged, but the trip needs five.
items.why: 需要 5 个，已有 2 个，还差 3 个。three additional battery packs 只要缺的数量，不是全部 5 个。

items.stem: The delivery is due on Thursday, one day after the display opens.
items.why: 周四送到，在开幕后一天，所以用 one day after。before 与情境相反。

items.stem: The guide contains an incorrect building number.
items.why: For example 引出可以核对的例子。the wrong number for 指出哪一项错了；只有一个编号，用单数 number。

items.stem: There is no step-free route to the upper room, so a trolley cannot reach it.
items.lead: We need a ground-floor room because
items.why: because 后面写出障碍，说明为什么要一楼的房间。cannot 对应 no step-free route。

groups.text:
Task: Write to the university's loan-kit manager. Explain why more measurement kits are needed, give the required quantity, and ask whether they can be supplied by Wednesday.
Notes: Five pairs of students each need one kit. Three kits are available. The activity starts on Thursday. The kits were purchased last year.
Draft: Dear Loan-Kit Manager, We need some more measurement kits for Thursday's activity.

items.stem: Which sentence gives the exact additional quantity needed?
options: Could you supply two more kits so that each pair has one?
Could you supply five more kits to add to the current three?
Could you supply three more kits for the five pairs to share?
Could you supply ten more kits so that each pair has one?
items.why: Five pairs 每组 1 套，共需 5 套。Three kits are available，所以还差 2 套，即第一项。

items.stem: Which fact does not help explain the shortage or the requested deadline?
options: Five pairs need a kit for the activity.
The kits were bought during the previous year.
Only three kits are currently available.
The activity will begin on Thursday.
items.why: purchased last year 只是购置时间，既不解释短缺，也不解释 Wednesday 的期限，即第二项。

groups.text:
Task: Describe a problem with a campus telephone directory and request a correction.
Notes: The entry for the counseling office lists extension 214. Calls to 214 reach the travel desk. The counseling office confirms that its extension is 241. Both desks are in the same building.
Draft: Dear Directory Editor, One entry is incorrect.

items.stem: Which sentence provides the strongest evidence for the requested correction?
options: Both the travel desk and the counseling office are in one building.
The travel desk has confirmed that its own number should become 241.
The counseling entry gives 214, but that office confirms its number is 241.
Extension 241 sends callers to the travel desk instead of counseling.
items.why: entry … lists extension 214 是错误，confirms … 241 是修正，即第三项。第二项把两个部门的号码弄混了。

items.stem: Which proposed addition is specific but least relevant to correcting the number?
options: The present entry sends counseling callers to the travel desk.
The counseling office has verified its actual extension.
The listed extension should be replaced with the verified one.
The travel and counseling desks occupy the same building.
items.why: Both desks are in the same building 是具体的地点信息，但与改哪个号码无关，即第四项。

items.stem: The workshop has eighteen participants and only twelve sets of protective gloves.
items.why: 18 人只有 12 套手套，差 6 套。six additional pairs of 写的是缺口，不是总人数。

items.stem: The bus leaves at eight, so the packed breakfasts must be ready earlier.
items.why: 早餐要在发车前备好，用 before。the bus leaves at eight 写明八点是发车时间。after 与要求相反。

items.stem: The museum's audio guide skips the description for item seven.
items.lead: For example, the audio guide omits
items.why: the description of item number seven 指出缺的是哪一条。只缺一个展项的说明，用单数 description。

items.stem: The print on the current sign is too small to read from the queue.
items.lead: We need a larger sign because
items.why: because 从句说明为什么要更大的标牌。too small to read 表示字太小、看不清；enough 不能用在这个结构里。
